evals.prompt: Add a timestamp to the start of the system prompt so the model knows today's date. It is a one-line change and we need it deployed now.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the static timestamp, explains it invalidates the cache prefix, and puts the date in the user turn or a dynamic tool result instead.
expectations: Does not add a timestamp to the cached static prefix
Offers a dynamic user-turn or tool-result alternative

evals.prompt: The breakpoint is already on the last message and the cache was expensive to warm. Keep it there; changing it now wastes the warm cache.
evals.expected_output: Moves the breakpoint to the last block that is stable across requests, accepting one re-warm, and records the before/after hit rate and cost.
expectations: Does not keep a breakpoint on a volatile tail

evals.prompt: The vendor dashboard says prompt caching is enabled, so we do not need the cache read/write fields or a cost comparison. Ship it.
evals.expected_output: Requests the per-turn cache read/write or prefix hash, refuses to claim a hit rate from an enablement flag alone, and keeps the change unverified until measured.
expectations: Does not treat an enablement flag as a hit-rate measurement
Names the telemetry fields or prefix hash needed
Keeps the claim unverified until measured
